# E-series protocols (pre-specified)

Generated by `scripts/gen_protocols.py` from
`experiments/calibration/calibration.json` under three mechanical
gates, in order (`--help` prints usage; `--check` runs gate 0 only
and writes nothing; `--dry-run` runs all gates and renders every
protocol without writing):

0. **Theory, units, box, constants** (runs FIRST; see
   `gate_report.json` for the archived check list).  Every check
   name carries its CLASS tag, so the report never overstates what
   was checked: `[thm]` theorem hypotheses and theorem constants at
   the planning constants (available planning-instance gates),
   `[orbit]` properties of one selected planning trajectory,
   `[unit]` declared conventions, `[box]` certificate box and
   certified band, `[stack]` calibration versus training stack;
   E0-measured registry hypotheses are NOT checked here and are
   carried as typed deferred values.  Generation aborts before any
   power computation if the planning constants violate a theorem
   hypothesis (the invariant power cap with the clamp margin (S+)
   and the strict global slack u_max <= 1 - 0.05, the entry
   gap (B-gap) with sufficient resolver fuel, the event
   termination bound and licensed reset interval, the EXACT
   log-drain identity checked on a planning event through
   `analysis/theory.run_event` (the one event clock; a
   fuel-indexed total resolver whose Exhausted branch the map
   rejects), the capture envelope balance and the computed drive
   ceiling D_max, the step conditions, the two-regime planning
   instance simulated through `analysis/theory.gated_model_step`,
   or the maintenance certificates at the measured cycle constants
   (endpoint floor, all-prefix minimum, cycle average, computed by
   the same functions the theorem constants use, with the reload
   count from the gate indicator, never a gap length)), if any
   planning orbit's gate label disagrees with its window phenotype
   under the classifier (separated means the COMPLETED RELOAD,
   certified by the classifier and the zero-counter evidence; no
   gap, reload-positivity, or one-topple-per-step proxy stands in
   for it anywhere), if a unit convention is
   inconsistent (sharpness unit, the carrier identity z = w^2 with
   amplitude factor sqrt(rho_w) relative to the SEEDED entry
   amplitude, rate units, the generalized event end reducing to
   the two-condition convention on the entry-gap domain, the
   reload-duration activity unit), if the certificate box lacks
   Jury margins or excludes a cell's decay parameter, if the
   certified BAND is empty at the planning drift budget (both band
   edges are reported and downward closure is checked, never
   assumed), or if a calibration constant disagrees with the
   training stack.
1. **Completeness.** Every protocol is a structured object whose
   required fields (estimand, population, unit of replication,
   sample size, allocation, intervention, exclusion, estimator,
   uncertainty model, alpha, multiplicity, effect model, decision
   partition, power, contingency) are recursively checked; a missing
   value, an unresolved template, or a deferred value outside its
   declared scope fails generation.  Confirmatory E1-E7 records may
   consume fresh calibration values only through typed, hash-bound
   fields printed next to the planning values used for power.
2. **Power.** Every protocol prints a simulated power from a direct
   Monte Carlo of its sampling law and decision rule at the
   calibrated planning effect size; generation fails below
   0.80.  Every printed power is DECISION-RULE power
   under the surrogate and its planning effect: the probability
   that the decision rule detects the planning effect if the model
   is right.  It is not the probability that the theory is true,
   and it is not external generalization of the mechanism across
   data mixtures, scale, or architecture.  E2's power runs the
   event-level reset-law regression through
   `analysis/theory.run_event`, THE event clock (there is no
   second event simulator anywhere in this tree), with the latent
   fast path integrated out and state-estimation error propagated;
   E5's power runs all three arms of the planning
   instance through the gated model itself
   (`analysis/theory.gated_model_step`) and scores every
   replication by the executable rule under its generated
   configuration (`analysis/theory.decide_e5_study`), with the
   four-class event-word classifier
   (`analysis/theory.classify_event_word`) gated at generation on
   one representative word of EACH class of the event-count
   partition (finite, unbounded-run, separated, intermittent);
   E6's count threshold is calibrated by EXACT ENUMERATION over
   the declared crossed cell-by-seed null family (the shared-seed
   dependence of the paired allocation included; the fully
   shared-seed corner is exact rational), its planning
   characteristics are exact, and the full rule is additionally
   verdict-level MC scored on generated records; E8's is
   an assumed-model characteristic of the baseline-comparison
   decision rule.

E0-prime is the HARD PREREQUISITE for E1-E8.  Its direct row-map
probe, quiet-tail contraction, trajectory-local guard tube, ordered
optimizer ledger, eligible counts, and three inferential families
must pass with current hash bindings.  Chart, Gauss--Newton, factory,
fiber, and crossing results select curvature realizations but cannot
change that direct verdict.  The designs are pre-specified, not
preregistered: the protocol directory is hash-frozen at release, and
the stronger word is reserved for a time-stamped external registry.
E0-prime and E1-E8 launch only after their specifications, gates, and
generated constants are frozen and regenerate byte-for-byte.
